lines: 看这粒火星。|碰到油，整座洞穴就出事了。
Watch this spark.|It touches oil, and the cave is in trouble.
这团混乱，不是一段播好的动画。|沙、水、火，都在现场按规则变化。
This chaos is not a prerecorded animation.|Sand, water and fire are changing under local rules.
这一期，拆开《Noita》的像素魔法。
This episode, we unpack the pixel magic of Noita.
先把洞穴放大。|一个格子，存一种材料。
First, zoom into the cave.|Each cell stores a material.
画面每前进一步，|材料就检查身边的格子，再决定移动或反应。
At each simulation step,|materials inspect nearby cells, then move or react.
这里是教学重演，|不是游戏源码，也不代表原版性能。
This is an educational reconstruction,|not the game's source code or a measure of its performance.
先只倒沙。|下面空着，就往下掉。
Start with sand alone.|If the cell below is empty, fall into it.
正下方堵住，再试两条斜路。|都走不通，就停下来。
If blocked below, try the two diagonals.|If neither works, stay put.
没有人画沙堆的轮廓。|一粒粒沙重复这条规则，坡就长出来了。
Nobody draws the outline of the pile.|Grains repeat the same rule, and a slope emerges.
换成水，多给它一条路：|落不下去，还能往两边流。
Water gets another option:|when it cannot fall, it can spread sideways.
看它绕过石头，灌进低处。|沙沉进水里，油浮在水上。
Watch it flow around rock and into low ground.|Sand sinks through water; oil stays above it.
材料不必认识整座洞穴。|眼前几个邻居，就能改变大场面。
A material need not know the whole cave.|A few nearby cells can reshape the scene.
现在，把火放进来。|火碰到油和木头，会点燃邻居。
Now add fire.|Touching oil or wood can ignite a neighboring cell.
燃料被消耗，烟往上飘。|一处接触，变成一串连锁反应。
Fuel is consumed and smoke rises.|One contact becomes a chain reaction.
意外就藏在这里：|规则很短，碰在一起的结果却很难预料。
This is where accidents begin:|short rules combine into outcomes that are hard to predict.
可洞穴这么大，每次都扫一遍？|大部分石头，明明根本没动。
But must every step scan the entire cave?|Most of that rock has not moved at all.
把世界切成块。|发生变化的区域亮起来，安静的区域先休息。
Divide the world into chunks.|Changing regions light up; quiet regions can sleep.
移动和反应，会唤醒附近的块。|右边显示的，是这次演示实际访问的格子数。
Movement and reactions wake nearby chunks.|The readout shows cells actually visited in this reconstruction.
拉回洞穴。|现在你看到的，是无数条小规则正在相遇。
Pull back to the cave.|You are watching countless small rules meet.
而下一场事故，|也许只差一粒火星。
And the next accident|may be just one spark away.
